source_location: Annexure 5.1 'Financial Parameters', printed page 5.30 (PDF page 156): capex '6 Cr to 20 Cr' per MW (13 is our midpoint; the footnote says hydro capex is per project, from developers and CEA revised cost estimates), O&M 2.5% of capex, life 40 years. source_name: CEA, National Electricity Plan 2022-32 Vol I Generation (May 2023)

source_name: CEA, National Electricity Plan 2022-32 Vol I Generation (May 2023)
